# === Module System and Import Hook ===

# --8<-- [start:import_from_directive]
-import_from(myapp.graphs.utils, [ShortestPath, Reachable])
# --8<-- [end:import_from_directive]

# --8<-- [start:alias_directive]
-import_from(myapp.graphs.utils, [alias(Reachable, Reach)])
# --8<-- [end:alias_directive]

# --8<-- [start:import_module_directive]
-import_module(myapp.graphs.utils)
# --8<-- [end:import_module_directive]

# --8<-- [start:qualified_name_errors]
Bad(X) <- X.foo(X)      # SyntaxError: Logic variable 'X' cannot appear
Bad(X) <- mod.X(X)      # SyntaxError: Logic variable 'X' cannot appear
# --8<-- [end:qualified_name_errors]

# --8<-- [start:qualified_constant_access]
circumference(R, C) <- (C == 2 * other_module._PI_ * R)   # bare term
half_pi(X) <- (X is ++(other_module._PI_ / 2))              # ++ escape
# --8<-- [end:qualified_constant_access]

# --8<-- [start:import_from_constants]
-import_from(other_module, [_PI_])                   # direct
-import_from(other_module, [alias(_PI_, _MYPI_)])    # alias — both sides must be constant-shaped
# --8<-- [end:import_from_constants]
